items.title: A view with no description fails the lint
An element with no description fails the lint
An unlabelled relationship fails the lint
A context view with no person fails the lint
A container that neither runs nor stores fails the lint
A relationship that publishes an unknown event fails the lint
A view with more elements than the configured limit warns
A person or system description longer than the configured limit fails the lint
The lint prints the checklist items no machine can judge
A bounded context with no component view fails the lint
A component that owns no feature file fails the lint
A feature file that belongs to no component fails the lint
Components of different contexts relate only through an event
The tests check requires results
Each task is run as rdm-spec <task>
A task that passes exits 0
A task that finds a problem exits 1 and names it on the error stream
A task that cannot run exits 2 and says why
An unknown task exits 2 and lists the tasks
A task's results directory defaults to the configured one
A failing test command fails verification
Verify reads the cycle before anything else it does
A cycle with no cycle.edn is refused
The checkout's implementation is replaced by the room's, never merged with it
Edits the builder made outside the implementation are not used
The builder's tests are told where to write their results
The tests check passes when the builder's tests pass and every scenario's results passed
A scenario no test names fails verification
Verify writes ratified.edn with the cut, the room's tree, the outcome and every check
A failed verification is recorded with its reason
A cut holding an unstamped scenario is not verified
A failed or broken result fails verification
A task's results directory is --results, else RESULTS_DIR, else the configured one
The oracle passes when every output matches its golden
An output that differs from its golden fails the oracle, naming the difference
Recording goldens says which changed, and why
Recording without a reason is refused
Fence and verify refuse while the oracle fails
A project with no oracle is not refused
A task with no gate reports the findings of every stage
The components whose feature files changed are listed as scopes
A changed file no component owns is named for a person to judge
A component's design prose is its own
The oracle reads one oracle.edn, flat, one key per judging component
An oracle that holds no fixture cycle fails
An oracle the store does not hold cannot run
A changed event's publisher and subscribers are scopes
The kernel first, then each publisher before its subscribers
Verify reports every declared check, in order, with its outcome and margin
The first check that fails stops the gate, and the rest are named as not run
A configuration verify cannot trust is refused before anything runs
A check whose command is not found refuses the gate
A served app that answers and passes its probe passes, with its margin
An app that does not answer within its budget fails, naming the budget
A port already held refuses the gate rather than measure another process
An app that answers but fails its probe is not this application
A command that answers otherwise than expected fails the check
The oracle's result is exactly this shape
Each judging component is run on its fixture cases and compared with their goldens
Recording adds the goldens of new cases freely, and changes an existing one only when named
A named change to an existing golden is recorded with its component and case
A result that breaks the mapping fails the tests check, naming the scenario and the element
A mapping verify cannot read is refused before anything runs
A configuration with no :allure is held to rdm-spec's default mapping
A project without a domain model is not asked for one
The domain model is one EDN file of this shape
An element with no source, or a source that is not recorded, is a finding
A domain model that breaks a rule is a finding naming the element
A domain model that keeps every rule passes
A project that lets its contexts relate by call is not held to events only
A change to an event's description alone reaches no component
An app that accepts connections but never sends an HTTP response does not answer
